title: feat(plugin-grid): declare the host-driven external-pagination contract and type-check its tests (#4277, #4040)
body:
Closes #4277. Part of #4040 — tranche 2, package 1 of 3. This is the tranche-1 blocker: `@object-ui/plugin-grid` stopped on a public-type question, filed it, and stayed in `TEST_DEBT` until the PM ruled.

## The ruling this executes

#4277 was ruled on 2026-08-11 (option **B**, plus a derivation pin). Quoted verbatim — a ruling rewritten is a ruling changed:

> **裁决:B,加一条派生令。**
>
> 1. **C 否**:12 个 `(rest as any)` 读实现的是 framework#2212 的**宿主驱动外部分页路径**,`:418` 的注释自证 deliberate。把宿主能力裁成"内部逃生门"与实测意图相悖——能力存在就该可声明、可检查。
> 2. **A 弃,B 立**:external-pagination 是与普通 authoring surface 不同类的**模式契约**,值得独立命名(`ObjectGridExternalPaginationProps` 或相近),`ObjectGridProps` extends 之。12 个成员平铺进已有 12 成员的接口会抹掉这条模式边界。
> 3. **派生令(反漂移,执行时的硬约束)**:卡片自己指出同一词汇已在 `DataTableSchema`(`packages/types/src/data-display.ts:400+`)声明过一次,且 ObjectGrid 在 `:2207` 原样转发。新接口中与 `DataTableSchema` 语义对应的成员必须**类型级派生**(Pick / 映射)自那份声明,不得手抄第二份 12 项枚举——两处一旦手抄,下次漂移就在这两份之间发生。仅 grid 独有、`DataTableSchema` 无对应物的成员才允许显式声明,并逐一注明为何无对应。
> 4. 实施随裁决落地:12 处 `(rest as any)` 读改为类型化解构;`serverPagination.test.tsx` 无 cast 编译;#4277 记录的另两处机械修复(`importMissingRequiredHint` fixture、`useBulkExecutor` stub 签名)同 PR 收尾;plugin-grid 移出 TEST_DEBT。changeset 建议 minor(声明既有接受面 = 能力显形)。`ObjectGridRenderer` 的 `any` 索引签名(C 的附带项)**不并入**——那是所有 block renderer 的通用形状,单独议。

`ObjectGridRenderer`'s `any` index signature is therefore **not** touched here.

## Measured before / after — re-measured, not read off the registry

| | errors |
|---|---|
| declared in `TEST_DEBT` | 2 (code-tier) |
| measured on this branch's base (`421c145af`), template as-is | 5 — 1 config-tier + **4 code-tier** |
| after | **0** |

The registry number was two tranches stale, which is why tranche 2 was dispatched to re-measure rather than trust it. The one config-tier error is `TS2550` — `Array.prototype.at` in `column-features.test.tsx` / `columnIdentity.test.tsx` — resolved by the test project's `lib`, not by a code change. The four code-tier ones, verbatim:

```
src/__tests__/importMissingRequiredHint.test.tsx(35,6): error TS2741: Property 'dataSource' is missing in type '{ objectName: string; fields: …[]; open: true; onOpenChange: () => void; }' but required in type 'ImportWizardProps'.
src/__tests__/serverPagination.test.tsx(182,11): error TS2322: Type '{ schema: any; dataSource: any; data: …; manualPagination: true; rowCount: number; page: number; pageSize: number; onPageChange: Mock; onPageSizeChange: Mock; }' is not assignable to type 'IntrinsicAttributes & ObjectGridProps'.
  Property 'data' does not exist on type 'IntrinsicAttributes & ObjectGridProps'.
src/__tests__/useBulkExecutor.test.ts(406,15): error TS2352: Conversion of type 'undefined' to type 'unknown[]' may be a mistake …
src/__tests__/useBulkExecutor.test.ts(406,42): error TS2493: Tuple type '[]' of length '0' has no element at index '1'.
```

## What changed

**`ObjectGridExternalPaginationProps`** (`src/ObjectGrid.tsx`) names the host-driven mode; `ObjectGridProps` extends it. Eleven of its twelve members are type-derived from `DataTableSchema` — the very type ObjectGrid forwards them to at `:2207` — as

```ts
Partial< Pick< DataTableSchema,
  'data' | 'manualPagination' | 'rowCount' | 'page' | 'pageSize'
  | 'onPageChange' | 'onPageSizeChange' | 'sort' | 'onSortChange'
  | 'search' | 'onSearchChange' > >
```

so there is exactly one written-out signature per member in the repository, and the pair cannot drift. `Partial` is the only shape change and it is deliberate: the whole mode is opt-in, while `DataTableSchema['data']` is required because a table always has rows — a grid that is given no `data` fetches its own.

The twelfth, `onColumnStateChange`, is **explicit, with its reason**: `DataTableSchema` has no counterpart to derive from. The table vocabulary reports column changes as separate per-event callbacks (`onColumnResize(columnKey, width)`, `onColumnReorder(newOrder)`), whereas this one reports the merged, persisted `{ order, widths }` layout after ObjectGrid has folded either event into the state it also writes to `localStorage` — a different payload fired at a different moment. Its shape is exported as `ObjectGridColumnState` and reused by the component's own state hook, so those two cannot drift either.

**The twelve `(rest as any)` reads became typed destructuring**, which left `...rest` referenced by nothing, so it is gone. Two consequences worth stating rather than burying:

- `saveColumnState`'s dependency array was `[columnStorageKey, rest]`. `rest` is a fresh object on every render, so the callback was never actually memoized; it is now `[columnStorageKey, onColumnStateChange]`. Strictly more stable, no behavior change.
- Props that no longer land in `rest` were already going nowhere — `rest` was never spread onto anything — so dropping it changes nothing at runtime.

**Two mechanical fixes** recorded on #4277 so they would travel with the package:

- `importMissingRequiredHint.test.tsx` omitted the required `ImportWizardProps.dataSource`. These cases never leave the mapping step, but the wizard probes the source for `listImportMappings` / `importRecords` / `listImportJobs` on render, so a capability-free `{}` is the accurate fixture, named and commented.
- `useBulkExecutor.test.ts` stubbed `runAggregate` as `vi.fn(async () => undefined)` while `BulkExecutorOptions.runAggregate` is `(def, rows, params)` and the hook dispatches all three. vitest records the real arguments whatever the declared signature, so the cases that read `mock.calls[0][1]` passed at runtime and lied to the compiler; both reads were papered over with casts. A shared `aggregateStub()` declares the three parameters, and **both casts are deleted** — the assertions now read the real declared tuple instead of asserting through a hole.

## Discrimination proof — three probes, all reverted, none in the diff

**1. The new test project can fail** (the #3009 third failure mode: a `tsconfig.test.json` that exists but nothing runs). A provably-false line appended to `serverPagination.test.tsx`:

```
$ npx tsc -p tsconfig.test.json
src/__tests__/serverPagination.test.tsx(217,7): error TS2322: Type 'string' is not assignable to type 'number'.
EXIT:2
```

**2. The declaration is what makes it compile.** Removing only `extends ObjectGridExternalPaginationProps` from `ObjectGridProps` — the pre-fix contract, exactly — goes red:

```
$ npx tsc -p tsconfig.test.json
src/ObjectGrid.tsx(345,3): error TS2339: Property 'data' does not exist on type 'ObjectGridProps'.
src/ObjectGrid.tsx(346,3): error TS2339: Property 'manualPagination' does not exist on type 'ObjectGridProps'.
src/ObjectGrid.tsx(347,3): error TS2339: Property 'rowCount' does not exist on type 'ObjectGridProps'.
src/ObjectGrid.tsx(348,3): error TS2339: Property 'page' does not exist on type 'ObjectGridProps'.
src/ObjectGrid.tsx(349,3): error TS2339: Property 'pageSize' does not exist on type 'ObjectGridProps'.
src/ObjectGrid.tsx(350,3): error TS2339: Property 'onPageChange' does not exist on type 'ObjectGridProps'.
src/ObjectGrid.tsx(351,3): error TS2339: Property 'onPageSizeChange' does not exist on type 'ObjectGridProps'.
src/ObjectGrid.tsx(352,3): error TS2339: Property 'sort' does not exist on type 'ObjectGridProps'.
… (12 in total, plus the original TS2322 at the test's call site)
EXIT:2
```

Worth reading precisely, because it is not where the template presumes the red lands: the errors surface at the **source destructuring**, not only at the test. That is the point — before this PR those twelve reads were `(rest as any)` and the compiler had no opinion about any of them; now every one is load-bearing at the definition site, so deleting the declaration breaks the component itself rather than just one call site.

**3. The derivation is live, not a hand copy that happens to match.** Passing a wrong-typed handler in the test:

```
$ npx tsc -p tsconfig.test.json     # onPageChange={(p: string) => onPageChange(p)}
src/__tests__/serverPagination.test.tsx(187,11): error TS2322: Type '(p: string) => any' is not assignable to type '(page: number) => void'.
  Types of parameters 'p' and 'page' are incompatible.
    Type 'number' is not assignable to type 'string'.
EXIT:2
```

`(page: number) => void`, parameter name and all, is `DataTableSchema.onPageChange` verbatim — the error is quoting `packages/types`, which is what the derivation pin asks for. A hand-copied enumeration would produce the same message today and drift silently tomorrow; this one cannot.

## Verification

```
$ pnpm --filter @object-ui/plugin-grid type-check
> tsc --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.typetests.json && tsc -p tsconfig.test.json
EXIT:0

$ npx vitest run packages/plugin-grid --maxWorkers=2      # repo root, per objectui#3378
 Test Files  58 passed (58)
      Tests  551 passed (551)

$ pnpm --filter @object-ui/plugin-grid lint
✖ 570 problems (0 errors, 570 warnings)                   # all pre-existing warnings

$ node scripts/check-type-check-coverage.mjs
type-check coverage: 43/45 via `type-check`, 1 via their own build, 0 known-broken (0 errors outstanding), 1 not compiled.
test type-check coverage: 28/40 packages compile their tests, 12 declared debt (235 errors outstanding), 10 with a narrow type-assertion project.

$ node scripts/check-changeset-presence.mjs
4 source file(s) of 1 released package(s) changed, and this change declares 1 changeset(s).
```

**Consumer sweep — downstream direction** (`--filter '...@object-ui/plugin-grid'`, the prefix form, i.e. the packages that DEPEND on plugin-grid). This changes an exported interface, so the closure was rebuilt first and the consumers type-checked against the freshly emitted `dist/index.d.ts`, not a stale one:

```
$ pnpm --filter '@object-ui/plugin-view^...' --filter '@object-ui/plugin-designer^...' build
$ pnpm --filter @object-ui/plugin-view --filter @object-ui/plugin-designer type-check
packages/plugin-view type-check: Done
packages/plugin-designer type-check: Done
```

Those two are the only packages with a typed `< ObjectGrid … />` call site besides `apps/console/src/dev/DevRowActions.tsx` (`schema` only). Everything else reaches the grid through `ObjectGridRenderer`, whose `any` index signature is out of scope by the ruling. The change is additive — every new member is optional — so no consumer can be narrowed by it; the sweep confirms rather than discovers.

`TEST_DEBT` shrinks by exactly this package's line; no other entry is touched.

## Changeset

`minor` for `@object-ui/plugin-grid`, per the ruling — declaring an already-accepted surface is a capability becoming visible, not a fix.
